AWeekOfChores
Ana plans her week. She writes down three chores, one with no date yet,
    hands one to Bo, finishes one and crosses it off, renames another, and
    moves the first one's due date back a day. Then she looks at what is left
    for her.

TheDayPasses
Bo starts with a chore that is already overdue and adds two more for the coming days. Two days
    go by. The second is overdue too and rises with the first; Bo can still rename the first, and can
    push it ahead, but not to a day that has passed.
ClearTheList\nAt the end of the week Ana removes everything, one chore at a time, and\n    the list says there is nothing to do. Removing one twice is turned away.

WrongTurns
Ana makes the mistakes a form lets her make: a blank title, a date that
    has passed, a colleague who does not exist. Each is turned away with its
    reason and the list is as it was. Then she gets it right.

SaveTwiceMakesOneTodo
Ana types a chore and, impatient, presses Save a second time while the
    first request is out. One todo lands, because Save is disabled while
    saving.

EditKeepsWhatWasTyped
Bo edits a chore and moves its date to last week by mistake. The form is
    refused with the reason, keeps what he typed, and the row is untouched. He
    fixes the date and saves.

OfflineShowsTheLastList
Ana adds two chores, then loses the network. The list she saw stays on
    screen with a banner, Save and Remove are off, and when the network returns
    the list is fresh again.

EveryLabelReadsInFrench
Opened in French, every control a reader can see carries its French label
    as its accessible name, on the list, the add form, the edit form and the
    remove dialog.

components:
  textbox 'Title'    field     'Title'    holds string ≤ 120 (required) as title

  GET /users

stored:

  description  any text  (starts "")
  due          YYYY-MM-DD or empty  (starts "")
  assignee     "" | "ana" | "bo"  (starts "")
  phase        idle | saving | refused  (starts idle)
  error        the last refusal's message, or empty  (starts "")

phases:
  idle       hides todo-saving, todo-error; because Save is enabled only when the title is not blank
  saving     shows todo-saving; disabled textbox 'Title', todo-description, todo-due, combobox 'Assignee', button 'Save'

  idle --[click button 'Save' only if title is not blank and online]--> saving
  saving --[201]--> idle; fields cleared; list refetched
  saving --[4xx or 5xx]--> refused; error = body.error; fields kept
  saving --[network error]--> refused; error = a generic message
  refused --[edit any field]--> idle; error hidden
  refused --[click button 'Save' only if title is not blank]--> saving

column4: - **(none)**: no todo is listed. Reached by: a fresh service, nothing done.
- **unscheduled**: 'Fix the gate' is listed with no due day. Reached by: AddTodo Fix the gate.
- **scheduled**: 'Fix the gate' is listed with a due day on or after today. Reached by: AddTodo Fix the gate.
- **overdue**: 'Fix the gate' is listed with a due day before today. Reached by: needs TodoRecord of services.api in overdue for ana.
- **Online**: every act reaches the store. Reached by: a fresh service, nothing done.
- **Offline**: the banner shows; Save and Remove are off; the list is the last fetch. Reached by: SetNetwork offline.
- **StoreDown**: an act that reaches the store is turned away with the API's words. Reached by: SetStore down.
